title: createCollection
subtitle: Normalized list of entities with per-id resources
description: Framework-agnostic collection: Map-backed CRUD, optional sort, subscribe, and getResource(id) for row-level drafts.

callouts.title: Local only (alpha)
callouts.content: No built-in fetch/pagination. Load remotely, then setAll. React apps should prefer useCollection.

rows.name: config.getId
rows.description: Unique id extractor for normalization and lookups.

rows.name: config.sortBy
rows.description: Comparator re-run after writes. Omit to keep insertion order.

behavior.title: Normalized storage
behavior.description: entities Map + ids array. Lookups are O(1); selectAll maps ids → entities.

behavior.title: sortBy after writes
behavior.description: If provided, ids are re-sorted after add/update/setAll.

behavior.title: setAll resets resources
behavior.description: Clears the resource cache so stale drafts cannot outlive replaced data.

dos: Always provide stable string ids via getId
Use useCollection in React instead of createCollection + manual subscribe
destroy() when the collection is no longer needed (vanilla)
donts: Don't treat this as a remote query cache
Don't mutate entities in place — use updateOne / setAll
Don't share one getResource across different logical lists without remounting
